files.tool.toml:
name = "doc_full"
description = "  Herramienta completa.  "
command = ["code", "--ruta", "{ruta}", "--n", "{n}", "--modo", "{modo}", "--activo", "{activo}", "--ratio", "{ratio}"]
level = 1
timeout_s = 2.5
untrusted_output = true

[params.ruta]
type = "string"
description = "Ruta de lectura."
validate = "path_in_read_roots"

[params.n]
type = "integer"
minimum = 1
maximum = 10
required = false

[params.modo]
type = "string"
validate = "enum:rapido, lento"

[params.activo]
type = "boolean"
required = false

[params.ratio]
type = "number"
minimum = 0.0
